# LVGL source dependency

Unmodified upstream LVGL v9.6.0, Git revision
`80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39`, from
[lvgl/lvgl](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/tree/80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39).
Retained paths: `src/`, `include/`, `env_support/`, `CMakeLists.txt`,
`lvgl.h`, `lv_version.h`, and `LICENCE.txt`. Demos, examples, tests and upstream
documentation are omitted. No vendored source is modified.

`upstream-sha256.txt` records every retained upstream file's SHA-256 and relative
path. Application configuration and adapters live in `native/selected-lab/`.
The dependency is built by upstream CMake with demos, examples, external
dependencies and network fetching disabled. The MIT notice in `LICENCE.txt`
must accompany substantial source or binary redistribution.
